productionRef.reason: No separate Supabase test project exists yet. e2e drives the live project because that is the only database the app is wired to. The marker convention (docs/agents/e2e-fixture-convention.md) plus the collateral gate on scripts/sweep-e2e-markers.mjs are what make this currently survivable: every fixture is identifiable and removable, and a marker parent whose deletion would cascade into a real parent's row stops the sweep. The 2026-10-03 incident is what that gate cost, and this waiver is the admission that it is mitigation and not a fix.
